mapper.insert: INSERT INTO training_knowledge_index_task (task_id, content_ids, status, requested_count, indexed_count, chunk_counts, error_message, attempt_no, max_attempts, next_retry_at, started_at, finished_at) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{contentIds}, #{status}, #{requestedCount}, #{indexedCount}, #{chunkCounts}, #{errorMessage}, #{attemptNo}, #{maxAttempts}, #{nextRetryAt}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT task_id, content_ids, status, requested_count, indexed_count, chunk_counts, error_message, attempt_no, max_attempts, next_retry_at, started_at, finished_at, created_at, updated_at FROM training_knowledge_index_task WHERE task_id = #{taskId}

SELECT task_id, content_ids, status, requested_count, indexed_count, chunk_counts, error_message, attempt_no, max_attempts, next_retry_at, started_at, finished_at, created_at, updated_at FROM training_knowledge_index_task WHERE status = 'QUEUED' AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ORDER BY created_at, task_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE training_knowledge_index_task SET status = 'RUNNING', attempt_no = attempt_no + 1, started_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, finished_at = NULL, next_retry_at = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND status = 'QUEUED' AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

UPDATE training_knowledge_index_task SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', indexed_count = #{indexedCount}, chunk_counts = #{chunkCounts}, error_message = NULL, next_retry_at = NULL, finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE training_knowledge_index_task SET status = CASE WHEN attempt_no < max_attempts THEN 'QUEUED' ELSE 'FAILED' END, error_message = #{errorMessage}, next_retry_at = CASE WHEN attempt_no < max_attempts THEN #{nextRetryAt} ELSE NULL END, finished_at = CASE WHEN attempt_no < max_attempts THEN NULL ELSE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND status = 'RUNNING'
UPDATE training_knowledge_index_task SET status = 'QUEUED', error_message = #{errorMessage}, next_retry_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE status = 'RUNNING'
